svg.title: Mali KBase Memory Management Structures Relationship

g.text: Mali KBase Memory Management Structures Relationship
«struct» rb_root reg_rbtree_same ' Tree for SAME_VA zone
«struct» rb_root reg_rbtree_custom ' Tree for CUSTOM_VA zone
«struct» rb_root reg_rbtree_exec ' Tree for EXEC_VA zone
«struct» list_head jit_active_head ' List of active JIT regions
«struct» list_head jit_pool_head ' List of pooled (free) JIT regions
«struct» list_head jit_destroy_head ' List of JIT regions to destroy
«struct» kbase_mem_pool_group mem_pools ' Memory pools for physical pages
atomic_t used_pages ' Tracks physical pages used by this context
int as_nr ' Address Space number for HW
unsigned long flags ' Context flags (e.g., KCTX_COMPAT)
unsigned long flags ' (KBASE_REG_CPU_WR, KBASE_REG_GPU_RD, KBASE_REG_FREE, KBASE_REG_ZONE_MASK, KBASE_REG_JIT_ALLOC, etc.)
«struct» kbase_mem_phy_alloc *cpu_alloc ' Physical alloc for CPU view
«struct» kbase_mem_phy_alloc *gpu_alloc ' Physical alloc for GPU view
«struct» rb_node rblink ' Node for address-sorted RB-Tree (in kbase_context)
«struct» list_head jit_node ' Node for JIT management lists (in kbase_context)
«struct» rb_root *rbtree ' Backlink to the RB-Tree root it belongs to
int va_refcnt ' Refcount for the region struct itself (e.g., by CPU mappings)
«struct» tagged_addr *pages ' Array of physical page addresses/info
size_t nents ' Number of valid entries in 'pages'
«struct» kref kref ' Overall refcount for this physical allocation
atomic_t gpu_mappings ' Count of GPU mappings using this
atomic_t kernel_mappings ' Count of kernel mappings using this
enum kbase_memory_type type ' (NATIVE, IMPORTED_UMM, IMPORTED_USER_BUF, ALIAS, etc.)
union imported { ... } ' Data specific to imported types (dma-buf, user_buf, alias info)
«struct» list_head mappings ' List of CPU mappings of this alloc
«struct» list_head evict_node ' Node for eviction list
«struct» kbase_va_region *reg ' Backlink to the region (if any)
A context manages its GPU VA space,
which is composed of multiple regions.
and JIT regions in specific lists
A VA region points to the physical
used to get physical pages for
It also tracks the total physical
